title: Expecting Empathy: How Interaction Context Shapes Norms for Empathic Response in Digital Communication

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating how empathy norms vary across three distinct online communities (career advice, entrepreneurship, and finance) and acknowledging that the findings may be specific to predominantly North American English-language contexts.
Analyzing community upvotes as a noisy proxy for response quality while identifying and controlling for position bias and social influence cascades in the data.
Evaluating the systematic underrepresentation of emotional intensity by large language models compared to human annotator baselines.
